content.comment_body: Hello! Can someone provide a schematic for the [product_name] expansion module connector? I need it urgently and would appreciate guidance in the right direction. Thanks, [user_name]
Could you describe your request in more detail? I’m not sure what specifically you’re looking for.

I’m referring to the interface between the [product_name] base and expansion module. I’m not entirely sure how to explain it. If you check the [product_name] system manual (EN-US), on page 17, object 11, you’ll find what I mean. Sorry for the unclear description; my English isn’t great. Best wishes, [user_name]
I’m also not fully certain what you mean, but did you look in the [product_name] Manual? Chapter 2 includes some schematics for [product_name]. [url] I hope this is helpful.

The expansion modules connect to the base module using a backplane bus. On the expansion module, there’s a plug on the left side and a socket on the other side for connecting to another module. Was this what you were asking?
Are you asking for a description of the plug cable and its socket?

Yes, exactly. Thank you. I’m looking for the description of each pin (like data+, data-, etc.). I can’t seem to find it anywhere. My internet is very slow, so searching is difficult. Could anyone assist? Thank you, [user_name]
For example, a USB stick is a plug and the port on your PC is a socket.
Unfortunately, I don’t think there is any published description for the pins. I don’t believe [company_name] has made this information available.
Understood. Thank you all for your responses.

Hi, In the German section of the forum, there is an article titled 'Logo-Bus-Verlängerung ... yes, it works.' There was a picture attached with connection details—please check the attachment. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested technical details for the connector pinout between [product_name] base and expansion modules, hoping for a schematic or detailed pin information. Several users tried to clarify the requirements and referenced the [product_name] system manual. Ultimately, it was agreed that the manufacturer does not make this detailed connector pin data publicly available, which frustrates users needing technical specifics and facing connectivity issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to find a readily accessible and detailed schematic or pinout description for the connector between [product_name] base and expansion modules, including pin-level details.
